history.description: Camp Travis emerged as a small rural settlement in Clay City Township, named for the nearby Travis Cemetery and the families who settled the surrounding farmland.
Throughout the early 20th century, the area served as a modest rural gathering point, tied closely to the agricultural development and road networks of Clay City Township.

Camp Travis remains a quiet, unincorporated community in Clay County. It is officially recognized as part of Clay City Township and is primarily characterized by its rural residential and agricultural landscape.
